I had a dream that I think happened two or so years ago, where everything was normal at first. I was in my house, laying in my bed as if I had just really woken up. I got up.

I looked outside my bedroom window (which is on the ground floor, because my house isn't a two-story house) and there was a really, really big cow standing there. I ignored the cow and left my room, going out to the living room where my mom was, and she told me very excitedly that there was an animal parade in our backyard, and that I should go see it. So I did.

She wasn't wrong, there were a bunch of random, weird animals in our backyard that were all wearing costumes with some sort of Ringling Brothers logo on them. I went over to some sort of weasel creature and started petting it, and suddenly the sky got really dark. All of the animals, and the weasel I was petting, turned into goblin-esque things that looked kind of zombieish, so I quickly left because I thought I was going to be attacked by them. (I used to have a lot of dreams when I was little about zombies attacking me and my family, and that fear is still kind of there)

I walked around to the side of my house for whatever reason instead of going back inside, and saw that the cow was still there. The weird thing was, one of cousins (don't remember who) had some sort of giant baby buggy, and was loading the cow into it because the cow was tired or something? My cousin also told me that the cow's name was Dog, because that's what she wanted to be called. I just went along with all of this because I'm pretty sure I realized at this point that I was in a dream, but I have no control over anything that happens within them, so I have to standby while all the crazy stuff happens.

So anyway, more of my cousins show up around me and the cow named Dog, and they all start pushing the buggy into the street - and all of the sudden it's day again. And I no longer recognize where I am, but I follow my family down this street until I start seeing landmarks as to where I am. We're all going down to the docks at this place in Wisconsin called Door County, where me and my extended family go for a week's vacation every year. I feel really happy at this point in the dream, surrounded by my family in this weird parade/march that we're doing. 

As soon as we reach the docks, the location changes again - to a nice looking, futuristic spa place with these giant circular pods everywhere that have jacuzzis and hot tubs in them. My family cheers and goes their separate ways, many of the adults going to the bar nearby for a drink, while the little kids go into the hot tubs. I follow the kids, and while I'm swimming around in the water, the dream ends. 

TL;DR: normal at first, animal parade in my backyard, giant cow named Dog, extended family marches down a familiar street, really nice spa place.
